task: Record per-phase reconcile timings in the watch path: expose a passive per-phase duration histogram (nfs_quota_agent_reconcile_phase_duration_seconds with phases lock_wait, apply, verify, status_update, other) rendered fresh on every scrape outside the 30s metrics cache and collector lock, and report per-phase deltas in Air-Gap E2E Stage D2 pre-bound phase, timing only with no behaviour change.

events.summary: Measure per-phase watch reconcile timings by adding passive timing around existing calls (lock_wait, apply, verify, status_update, other) exposing nfs_quota_agent_reconcile_phase_duration_seconds histogram rendered fresh on scrape, plus E2E Stage D2 pre-bound delta reporting and unit tests. Not touched: quota logic, argv construction, /etc/projects, lock acquisition ordering, chart/RBAC, cluster configuration, or HA standby/full sync.

Air-Gap E2E run 43152515457 measured the pre-bound watch path at 12.992 s (xfs), 8.080 s (ext4) and 13.528 s (btrfs) for 100 PVs, a filesystem-dependent rate, while no metric or log shows which reconcile phase the time is spent in.
A passive per-phase duration histogram in the watch-path reconcile plus per-phase deltas printed by the Stage D2 pre-bound phase, timing only with no behaviour change.
Local regression verification passed: gofmt clean, go vet ./..., go test for internal/agent, internal/metrics and cmd, and the scripts/e2e unit tests.

events.scope: Real quota commands on real xfs, ext4 and btrfs filesystems on 4 vCPU GitHub runners, kind control plane, agent QPS 50 / burst 100, 100 pre-bound PVs through the watch path, 200 observations per phase per filesystem (two watch reconciles per PV).
